basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a tech enthusiast based in Norman, Oklahoma. By day, I work as a software developer, mainly dabbling in open-source projects. Linux is my go-to for everything, and I'm always on the lookout for the latest in privacy-focused tech. When I'm not coding, you can find me exploring the latest trends in fashion, especially anything from Uniqlo. I’m also a bit of a retro gaming fan and enjoy playing Dr. Mario from time to time. Relationship-wise, I'm happily single, enjoying the freedom to dive into my hobbies. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings and late nights after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, which I pursued at a local university. My interests heavily lean towards Linux and privacy tech, which I've explored further through online courses and self-study. I've also gained practical experience by contributing to open-source projects.
